exposure: Smooth muscle myosin heavy chain expression in uterine scar tissue
Collagen type VI expression in uterine scar tissue
Endothelial cell marker CD31 expression in uterine scar tissue
Alpha smooth muscle actin expression in uterine scar tissue
Elastin expression in uterine scar tissue
cohort: 89 Caucasian women: 20 who experienced uterine scar rupture during repeat cesarean section and 69 who did not
finding: The immunohistochemical expression of elastin, collagen type VI, alpha smooth muscle actin, smooth muscle myosin heavy chain, and endothelial cell marker CD31 in uterine scar tissue was not significantly different between women who experienced uterine rupture and those who did not, suggesting these factors are not reliable predictors of rupture risk.
